verdict.rationale: Bento claims that every release is scored against production history offline, in CI, and on live traffic to catch regressions. It also says prompt and model changes are versioned and diffable, shows drift over prompt versions and regressions across deploys, and lets spans be tagged with experiment IDs. These cover the regression-detection goal, but nothing describes an explicit side-by-side comparison of eval runs, and all evidence is vendor marketing or docs. Missing for 10: an explicit side-by-side eval-run comparison view, documented eval-run and dataset workflow detail, independent or hands-on corroboration.
